title: AQUILA 2026.11.13.2
notes:
- Improved playback buffering, including large ASIO buffer sizes, and reduced repeated memory allocation during rendering.
- Host-loaded plugin state presets prepare while the current instance keeps playing, then switch only the selected instrument or effect with a short smoothing ramp. Held notes restart with the new sound; routing and automation remain connected. Failed loads preserve the current preset. Native program/bank selectors, plugin-internal preset browsers and existing effect tails are not covered by this transition.
- Attached Playlist and Mixer routing now follows explicit instrument and audio-track assignments. Attaching or detaching alone does not reroute the project, and the ordinary unattached Playlist keeps its existing workflow.
- Follow playhead is optional and off by default. Continuous following moves smoothly, and manual scrolling remains available.
- Save custom window layouts with positions and sizes and assign keyboard shortcuts to recall them. The last open, closed and resized window state is remembered across app restarts.
- Route selected Channel Rack tracks together or to consecutive Mixer inserts. Changing a selected row's Mixer number applies to the selected group. The Channel Rack expands to fit newly added channels.
- Choose the typing-keyboard piano octave from its keyboard options.
- Playlist Audio Timing now offers transient-detection Sensitivity. Adjust which attacks are detected before applying timing correction.
- Windows updates verify that the installer helper starts before closing the app. Failed update handoffs keep the current session open and provide clearer retry and diagnostic information.
- Help > About opens the build information. The illustrated offline User Guide includes searchable articles, detailed menus, linked topics and image enlargement, and can be detached onto another monitor.
